{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "build",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Removes Boost.Test from depends/packages/boost.mk, contrib/guix, vcpkg, and CMake build configuration.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Simplifies build and package maintenance across depends and Guix by eliminating Boost.Test as an external dependency. The PR description notes this removes packaging friction and allows cleaner toolchain integration, but it is not driven by an urgent dependency deadline or platform breakage."
    },
    {
      "name": "ipc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/ipc/test/ipc_tests.cpp only via a mechanical include replacement.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Not an IPC change; touches only IPC test include headers as part of a repo-wide test runner replacement."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/test/kernel/test_kernel.cpp only via a mechanical include replacement.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Not a kernel change; touches only the kernel test harness include header."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Adds a complete in-tree C++ test runner and assertion framework in src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp} and migrates main.cpp.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.68,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Replaces the external Boost.Test runner with an in-tree framework, resolving long-standing issues (#34666, #8670). The new framework provides expression decomposition for clearer assertion failures, works around historical signal stack bugs (#36045), and unblocks IWYU/clang-tidy usage as well as future CI concurrency improvements."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Only touches contrib/guix/libexec/build_linux.sh for Guix build environment setup.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The script modified is part of Guix build infrastructure rather than an operator or developer CLI tool."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches wallet unit test files purely through scripted include header updates.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not change wallet logic, interfaces, or wallet-specific test logic."
    }
